rows.graph_pool_attribution: Non-default segment pool IDs only; not all driver graph metadata
rows.timing_scope: Includes startup instrumentation; compact first compile-cache encounter; not steady-state execution latency
rows.budget_scope: gpu_memory_utilization=0.9 is native startup policy, not a measured exact 90% all-device hard cap; initial driver/context and runner allocations reported separately
rows.steady_nonkv_scope: Observed entire device used minus live unique KV storages; includes model, workspace, allocator, context and driver; NOT graph-exclusive residency

gpu_order: compact completed; dense lock-busy and not run
limitations: No between-plan cost effect or noise can be estimated from one completed endpoint
Counter values and native capture delta are not mutually additive
Cache cleanup never resizes already allocated KV
Current generated-token or service throughput evidence does not exist
